title: The Creation of Light
scene: God speaks light into being, and radiance breaks across the dark, formless deep.
commons_file: 001.The Creation of Light.jpg

title: The Creation of Eve
scene: While Adam lies in a deep sleep, the LORD God forms Eve and brings her to him.
commons_file: 002.The Creation of Eve.jpg

title: Adam and Eve Are Driven out of Eden
scene: Adam and Eve leave the garden while a cherub with a flaming sword guards the way behind them.
commons_file: 003.Adam and Eve Are Driven out of Eden.jpg

title: Cain and Abel Offer Their Sacrifices
scene: Cain and Abel offer their gifts on altars; the LORD accepts Abel's offering and not Cain's.
commons_file: 004.Cain and Abel Offer Their Sacrifices.jpg

title: Cain Slays Abel
scene: In the field Cain rises against his brother Abel and kills him, and Abel's blood cries out from the ground.
commons_file: 005.Cain Slays Abel.jpg

title: The Great Flood
scene: The last survivors cling to a rocky height as the waters rise over the highest hills.
commons_file: 007.The Great Flood.jpg

title: The World Is Destroyed by Water
scene: The ark rides the floodwaters while every living thing on the land perishes beneath them.
commons_file: 006.The World Is Destroyed by Water.jpg

title: A Dove Is Sent Forth from the Ark
scene: Noah sends a dove out from the ark over the waters to see whether they have gone down.
commons_file: 008.A Dove Is Sent Forth from the Ark.jpg

title: Noah Curses Canaan
scene: Noah wakes from his wine and pronounces a curse on Canaan and a blessing on Shem and Japheth.
commons_file: 009.Noah Curses Ham and Canaan.jpg

title: The Tower of Babel
scene: As the LORD confounds their language, the builders of the great tower in Shinar fall into confusion and despair, one man flinging his arms up toward heaven, while the work lies abandoned behind them.
commons_file: 010.The Tower of Babel.jpg

title: Abraham Goes to the Land of Canaan
scene: Abram sets out from Haran with Sarai, Lot, and his herds and camels toward the land of Canaan.
commons_file: 011.Abraham Goes to the Land of Canaan.jpg

title: Abraham and the Three Angels
scene: At Mamre, Abraham bows to the ground before three visitors and asks them to stay and rest.
commons_file: 012.Abraham and the Three Angels.jpg

title: Lot Flees as Sodom and Gomorrah Burn
scene: Lot and his daughters flee as fire falls on Sodom and Gomorrah, and his wife, looking back, becomes a pillar of salt.
commons_file: 013.Lot Flees as Sodom and Gomorrah Burn.jpg

title: Abraham Sends Hagar and Ishmael Away
scene: At Sarah's urging and with God's assurance, Abraham gives Hagar bread and water and sends her away with Ishmael.
commons_file: 014.Abraham Sends Hagar and Ishmael Away.jpg

title: Hagar and Ishmael in the Wilderness
scene: With the water spent and the empty bottle lying on the sand, Hagar kneels against a great rock with her arms raised over her head in grief, while Ishmael lies faint some distance away.
commons_file: 015.Hagar and Ishmael in the Wilderness.jpg

title: The Testing of Abraham's Faith
scene: Isaac climbs the rocky hillside with the wood for the burnt offering on his shoulders, as his father Abraham walks with him, staff in hand.
commons_file: 016.The Testing of Abraham's Faith.jpg

title: The Burial of Sarah
scene: Abraham buries Sarah in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in Hebron.
commons_file: 017.The Burial of Sarah.jpg

title: Eliezer and Rebekah at the Well
scene: At the well, Rebekah lowers her jar to give Abraham's servant a drink and then draws water for his camels.
commons_file: 018.Eliezer and Rebekah at the Well.jpg

title: Rebekah Sets Out to Meet Isaac
scene: Rebekah sets out on a canopied camel with Abraham's servant and her maids, while her family at the town gate lift their hands in farewell and weep to see her go.
commons_file: 019.The Meeting of Isaac and Rebekah.jpg

title: Isaac Blesses Jacob
scene: Blind and aged, Isaac feels Jacob's disguised hands and gives him the blessing meant for the firstborn.
commons_file: 020.Isaac Blesses Jacob.jpg

title: Jacob's Dream
scene: Sleeping with a stone for a pillow, Jacob dreams of a stairway to heaven with angels going up and down it.
commons_file: 021.Jacob's Dream.jpg

title: Jacob Tends Laban's Flocks and Meets Rachel
scene: At the well near Haran, Rachel stands with her water jar on her shoulder while Jacob, shepherd's staff in hand, sits watching over Laban's flock.
commons_file: 022.Jacob Tends Laban's Flocks and Meets Rachel.jpg

title: Jacob Prays for Protection
scene: Afraid of meeting Esau, Jacob humbly prays to the God of Abraham and Isaac for deliverance.
commons_file: 023.Jacob Prays for Protection.jpg

title: Jacob Wrestles with the Angel
scene: Left alone at night by the Jabbok, Jacob wrestles until daybreak and receives a blessing and the name Israel.
commons_file: 024.Jacob Wrestles with the Angel.jpg

title: Jacob and Esau Meet
scene: Jacob bows seven times as he approaches, and Esau runs to embrace and kiss him, and they weep together.
commons_file: 025.Jacob and Esau Meet.jpg

title: Joseph Is Sold by His Brothers
scene: Joseph's brothers draw him up from the pit and sell him to a passing caravan of merchants bound for Egypt.
commons_file: 026.Joseph Is Sold by His Brothers.jpg

title: Joseph Interprets Pharaoh's Dream
scene: Standing before the enthroned Pharaoh, Joseph explains that God has revealed seven years of plenty followed by seven years of famine.
commons_file: 027.Joseph Interprets Pharaoh's Dream.jpg

title: Joseph Reveals Himself to His Brothers
scene: Joseph sends out his attendants and, weeping, makes himself known to his astonished and fearful brothers.
commons_file: 028.Joseph Reveals Himself to His Brothers.jpg

title: Jacob Goes to Egypt
scene: The aged Jacob sets out for Egypt with his household, their flocks and their water jars; Doré shows him riding high on a camel, where Genesis tells of the wagons Pharaoh sent to carry him.
commons_file: 029.Jacob Goes to Egypt.jpg

title: The Child Moses on the Nile
scene: The infant Moses lies in his ark of bulrushes, drifting among the reeds of the moonlit Nile, while angels hover above and keep watch over him.
commons_file: 030.The Child Moses on the Nile.jpg

title: The Finding of Moses
scene: Pharaoh's daughter and her maidens find the Hebrew infant in his basket among the reeds and are moved with compassion.
commons_file: 031.The Finding of Moses.jpg

title: Moses and Aaron Appear before Pharaoh
scene: Moses and Aaron stand before Pharaoh's throne to deliver God's command, and Aaron casts down his rod as a sign.
commons_file: 032.Moses and Aaron Appear before Pharaoh.jpg

title: The Fifth Plague: Livestock Disease
scene: A grievous pestilence strikes down the livestock of Egypt in the fields, while the cattle of Israel are spared.
commons_file: 033.The Fifth Plague. Livestock Disease.jpg

title: The Ninth Plague: Darkness
scene: A thick darkness that can be felt covers Egypt for three days, though the Israelites have light in their dwellings.
commons_file: 034.The Ninth Plague. Darkness.jpg

title: The Firstborn of the Egyptians Are Slain
scene: At midnight the firstborn of Egypt die, and a great cry of mourning rises from every Egyptian household.
commons_file: 035.The Firstborn of the Egyptians Are Slain.jpg

title: The Egyptians Ask Moses to Depart
scene: After the death of the firstborn, Pharaoh and the Egyptians urge Moses and Aaron to lead Israel out of Egypt in haste.
commons_file: 036.The Egyptians Ask Moses to Depart.jpg

title: The Egyptians Drown in the Sea
scene: As Moses stretches his hand over the sea, the waters return and overwhelm Pharaoh's chariots and horsemen.
commons_file: 037.The Egyptians Drown in the Sea.jpg

title: The Giving of the Law on Mount Sinai
scene: At the foot of Mount Sinai the people fall on their faces and lift their hands in awe as cloud and light rest on the mountain where the LORD has come down.
commons_file: 038.The Giving of the Law on Mount Sinai.jpg

title: Moses Breaks the Tables of the Law
scene: Seeing the golden calf and the dancing, Moses in anger casts down the tablets of the Law and breaks them at the foot of the mountain.
commons_file: 041A.Moses Breaks the Tables of the Law.jpg

title: Moses Comes Down from Mount Sinai
scene: Moses comes down from Mount Sinai carrying the two tablets of the testimony, his face shining from having spoken with God.
commons_file: 039.Moses Comes Down from Mount Sinai.jpg

title: The Spies Return from the Promised Land
scene: The spies return from Canaan with a great cluster of grapes carried on a pole between two men, showing the fruit of the land.
commons_file: 041B.The Spies Return from the Promised Land.jpg

title: The Death of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram
scene: The ground splits open beneath Korah, Dathan, and Abiram and their households, and fire from the LORD consumes the 250 men offering incense.
commons_file: 040.The Death of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.jpg

title: Moses Strikes the Rock
scene: Water streams from the rock Moses has struck, and the thirsty people crowd its banks to drink with their children and animals, as Moses stands above with his rod raised.
commons_file: 041.Moses Strikes the Rock at Horeb.jpg

title: The Bronze Serpent
scene: Afflicted by fiery serpents, the Israelites look to the bronze serpent Moses has set on a pole and are healed.
commons_file: 042.The Bronze Serpent.jpg

title: An Angel Appears to Balaam
scene: The angel of the LORD, sword drawn, stands in Balaam's path, and his donkey turns aside and falls down as Balaam strikes her.
commons_file: 043.An Angel Appears to Balaam.jpg

title: The Israelites Cross the Jordan River
scene: The armed men of Israel, with camels and riders, file across the bed of the Jordan toward the far bank, where the host of Israel already stretches to the horizon.
commons_file: 044. The Israelites Cross the Jordan River.jpg

title: An Angel Appears to the Israelites
scene: Near Jericho an angel stands on a height before the assembled host of Israel, one arm raised toward heaven, as many in the camp kneel and bow to the ground.
commons_file: 045. An Angel Appears to the Israelites.jpg

title: The Walls of Jericho Fall Down
scene: On the seventh day, at the priests' trumpet blast and the people's great shout, the walls of Jericho fall down flat.
commons_file: 046.The Walls of Jericho Fall Down.jpg

title: Joshua Spares Rahab
scene: At Joshua's command the two spies bring Rahab and her family safely out of Jericho, keeping the oath made to her.
commons_file: 047.Joshua Spares Rahab.jpg

title: Achan Is Stoned to Death
scene: In the valley of Achor, Achan, who took forbidden spoil from Jericho, is stoned by Israel and a heap of stones is raised over him.
commons_file: 048.Achan Is Stoned to Death.jpg

title: Joshua Burns the Town of Ai
scene: Flames and smoke rise over the city of Ai as Joshua's forces take it and lay it waste.
commons_file: 049.Joshua Burns the Town of Ai.jpg

title: The Army of the Amorites Is Destroyed
scene: The fleeing Amorite host is struck down on the descent of Beth-horon by great hailstones from heaven.
commons_file: 050.The Army of the Amorites Is Destroyed.jpg

title: Joshua Commands the Sun to Stand Still
scene: Joshua lifts his arm and calls on the sun to stand still over Gibeon and the moon over the valley of Ajalon.
commons_file: 051.Joshua Commands the Sun to Stand Still.jpg

title: Jael Kills Sisera
scene: Jael draws back the curtain of her tent to show Barak and his pursuing soldiers the man they seek: Sisera lying dead on the floor, slain with a tent peg.
commons_file: 052.Jael Kills Sisera.jpg

title: Deborah Praises Jael
scene: Deborah raises her song of victory to the LORD, blessing Jael above women.
commons_file: 053.Deborah Praises Jael.jpg

title: Gideon Chooses 300 Soldiers
scene: At the water of Harod, Gideon watches how his men drink and keeps the three hundred who lap from their hands.
commons_file: 054.Gideon Chooses 300 Soldiers.jpg

title: The Midianites Are Routed
scene: In the night the Midianite camp falls into panic and flight as Gideon's men sound trumpets and break their pitchers.
commons_file: 055.The Midianites Are Routed.jpg

title: The Death of Gideon's Sons
scene: At dusk the slain sons of Gideon lie heaped upon the ground as Abimelech's armed band marches away along the horizon.
commons_file: 056.The Death of Gideon's Sons.jpg

title: The Death of Abimelech
scene: Beneath the tower of Thebez, Abimelech lies bleeding beside the millstone a woman cast down on his head, as his soldiers gather over him.
commons_file: 057.The Death of Abimelech.jpg

title: Jephthah's Daughter Comes to Meet Her Father
scene: Jephthah's only daughter comes out to meet her returning father, dancing with arms flung wide as her companions play timbrels, cymbals, harp and trumpet.
commons_file: 058.Jephthah's Daughter Comes to Meet Her Father.jpg

title: Israelite Women Mourn with Jephthah's Daughter
scene: Jephthah's daughter and her companions go up into the mountains to mourn for two months.
commons_file: 059.Israelite Women Mourn with Jephthah's Daughter.jpg

title: Samson Slays a Lion
scene: On the way down to Timnath, with the Spirit of the LORD upon him, Samson grapples a roaring young lion among the rocks and tears it apart with his bare hands.
commons_file: 060.Samson Slays a Lion.jpg

title: Samson Destroys the Philistines with an Ass' Jawbone
scene: At Lehi, freed from his bonds, Samson strikes down the Philistines with the jawbone of an ass.
commons_file: 061.Samson Destroys the Philistines with an Ass' Jawbone.jpg

title: Samson Carries away the Gates of Gaza
scene: At midnight Samson lifts the doors and posts of Gaza's city gate onto his shoulders and carries them toward the hill before Hebron.
commons_file: 062.Samson Carries away the Gates of Gaza.jpg

title: Samson and Delilah
scene: Seated on a couch, Samson lifts a lock of his uncut hair as he tells Delilah all his heart, while she stands beside him with her eyes cast down.
commons_file: 063.Samson and Delilah.jpg

title: The Death of Samson
scene: Blind Samson prays for strength one last time, then bows between the pillars and brings the house down on the Philistine lords.
commons_file: 064.The Death of Samson.jpg

title: A Levite Finds a Woman's Corpse
scene: At dawn the Levite opens the door and finds his concubine fallen at the threshold after the night's violence.
commons_file: 065.A Levite Finds a Woman's Corpse.jpg

title: The Levite Carries the Woman's Body Away
scene: Getting no answer, the Levite lays the woman's body on his donkey and sets out for home.
commons_file: 066.The Levite Carries the Woman's Body Away.jpg

title: The Benjaminites Seize the Daughters of Shiloh
scene: Benjaminite men rush out of the vineyards to seize wives from the maidens dancing at the feast in Shiloh.
commons_file: 067.The Benjaminites Take the Virgins of Jabesh-gilead.jpg

title: Naomi and Her Daughters-in-Law
scene: On the road from Moab, Orpah kisses Naomi and turns back while Ruth clings to her and vows to go with her.
commons_file: 068.Naomi and Her Daughters-in-Law.jpg

title: Ruth and Boaz
scene: In the harvest field Boaz notices Ruth gleaning among the reapers and speaks kindly to her.
commons_file: 069.Ruth and Boaz.jpg

title: The Ark Is Returned to Beth-shemesh
scene: Two lowing cows draw the cart carrying the ark toward Beth-shemesh, and the reapers in the wheat harvest look up and rejoice.
commons_file: 070.The Ark Is Returned to Beth-shemesh.jpg

title: Samuel Blesses Saul
scene: On the hilltop the young Saul kneels before the aged Samuel, who grips his staff and lifts his face and open hand toward heaven in blessing.
commons_file: 070A.Samuel Blesses Saul.jpg

title: The Death of Agag
scene: At Gilgal, Samuel carries out judgment before the LORD on Agag, king of the Amalekites.
commons_file: 071.The Death of Agag.jpg

title: David Slays Goliath
scene: Standing on the fallen giant beside his great sword, David holds Goliath's severed head aloft as the Israelites cheer and the Philistines flee.
commons_file: 071A.David Slays Goliath.jpg

title: Saul Attempts to Kill David
scene: As David plays the harp, King Saul, troubled by an evil spirit, hurls his javelin at him.
commons_file: 072.Saul Attempts to Kill David.jpg

title: David Escapes through a Window
scene: Michal lets David down through a window by night so he can escape the men Saul sent to kill him.
commons_file: 073.David Escapes through a Window.jpg

title: David and Jonathan
scene: David and Jonathan embrace and weep as they part, bound by their oath before the LORD.
commons_file: 073A.David and Jonathan.jpg

title: David Shows Saul How He Spared His Life
scene: Outside the cave at En-gedi, David stands on a rock and holds up the piece of Saul's robe toward the king and his men on the cliff above.
commons_file: 074.David Shows Saul How He Spared His Life.jpg

title: Saul and the Witch of Endor
scene: At Endor the woman cries out as the form of Samuel rises, and Saul bows with his face to the ground.
commons_file: 075.Saul and the Witch of Endor.jpg

title: The Death of Saul
scene: Badly wounded on Mount Gilboa, Saul falls upon his own sword, and his armour-bearer dies beside him.
commons_file: 076.The Death of Saul.jpg

title: Jabesh-Gileadites Recover the Bodies of Saul and His Sons
scene: The valiant men of Jabesh-gilead travel all night to take the bodies of Saul and his sons down from the wall of Beth-shan.
commons_file: 077.Jabesh-Gileadites Recover the Bodies of Saul and His Sons.jpg

title: Combat between Soldiers of Ish-bosheth and David
scene: Twelve young men from Ish-bosheth's side and twelve of David's grapple at the pool of Gibeon and fall together.
commons_file: 078.Combat between Soldiers of Ish-bosheth and David.jpg

title: David Attacks the Ammonites
scene: Before the walls of conquered Rabbah, the Ammonite captives lie cast down on the ground as iron-bladed chariots are driven over them. Doré follows the Latin reading of 12:31; the KJV reads “harrows of iron”, and the BSB says David put them to work with iron tools.
commons_file: 079.David Attacks the Ammonites.jpg

title: The Death of Absalom
scene: Absalom hangs caught in the boughs of a great oak as Joab thrusts three darts into his heart.
commons_file: 080.The Death of Absalom.jpg

title: David Mourns the Death of Absalom
scene: In the chamber over the gate, King David weeps for his son, crying out for Absalom.
commons_file: 081.David Mourns the Death of Absalom.jpg

title: Rizpah’s Kindness toward the Dead
scene: Rizpah spreads sackcloth on the rock and guards the bodies of the hanged men, two of them her own sons, from birds by day and beasts by night.
commons_file: 082.Rizpah’s Kindness toward the Dead.jpg

title: Abishai Saves David's Life
scene: When David grows faint in battle, Abishai rushes to his aid and strikes down the giant Ishbi-benob.
commons_file: 083.Abishai Saves David's Life.jpg

title: The Judgment of Solomon
scene: Solomon orders the living child divided with a sword, and the true mother pleads for the baby's life.
commons_file: 084.The Judgment of Solomon.jpg

title: King Solomon in Old Age
scene: The aged King Solomon, crowned and white-bearded, sits in thought with a pen in one hand and a written scroll in the other, surrounded by the writings of the wisdom God gave him.
commons_file: 087.King Solomon in Old Age.jpg

title: Cedars Are Cut Down for the Jerusalem Temple
scene: Workmen fell the great cedars of Lebanon for the house Solomon will build to the name of the LORD.
commons_file: 085.Cedars Are Cut Down for the Jerusalem Temple.jpg

title: Solomon Receives the Queen of Sheba
scene: In Solomon's pillared hall the king stands by his throne and stretches out his hand in welcome as the queen of Sheba, her train borne by pages, approaches with attendants bearing gifts.
commons_file: 086.Solomon Receives the Queen of Sheba.jpg

title: The Disobedient Prophet Is Slain by a Lion
scene: The disobedient man of God lies dead in the road, with the lion and his donkey standing quietly beside the body.
commons_file: 088.The Disobedient Prophet Is Slain by a Lion.jpg

title: Elijah Raises the Son of the Widow of Zarephath
scene: Elijah cries to the LORD over the widow's son, who revives, and he gives the boy back to his mother alive.
commons_file: 089.Elijah Raises the Son of the Widow of Zarephath.jpg

title: The Prophets of Baal Are Slaughtered
scene: At Elijah's command the people seize the prophets of Baal and they are slain at the brook Kishon.
commons_file: 090.The Prophets of Baal Are Slaughtered.jpg

title: Elijah Is Nourished by an Angel
scene: Sitting beneath the juniper tree, Elijah looks up as an angel comes down to him with a jar of water and bread, bidding him arise and eat.
commons_file: 091.Elijah Is Nourished by an Angel.jpg

title: The Israelites Slaughter the Syrians
scene: Israel's chariots and spearmen drive through the fallen Syrian host at Aphek, the walled city rising on the hill behind.
commons_file: 092.The Israelites Slaughter the Syrians.jpg

title: The Death of Ahab
scene: Struck by an arrow shot at random, King Ahab is held up in his chariot as the battle rages, and he dies at evening.
commons_file: 093.The Death of Ahab.jpg

title: Elijah Destroys the Messengers of Ahaziah
scene: From a hilltop Elijah calls down fire from heaven, which consumes the captains and soldiers King Ahaziah sent to seize him.
commons_file: 094.Elijah Destroys the Messengers of Ahaziah.jpg

title: Elijah Ascends to Heaven in a Chariot of Fire
scene: A chariot and horses of fire part Elijah from Elisha as the prophet is taken up by a whirlwind into heaven.
commons_file: 095.Elijah Ascends to Heaven in a Chariot of Fire.jpg

title: Some Children Are Destroyed by Bears
scene: After youths from Bethel jeer at Elisha on the road, two she-bears come out of the wood upon them.
commons_file: 095.Some Children Are Destroyed by Bears.jpg

title: A Famine in Samaria
scene: During the Syrian siege, the king of Israel stands on the city wall above starving people as a woman cries out to him for help.
commons_file: 096.A Famine in Samaria.jpg

title: The Death of Jezebel
scene: At Jehu's command, the painted queen Jezebel is thrown down from her window at Jezreel.
commons_file: 097.The Death of Jezebel.jpg

title: Jehu's Companions Find Jezebel's Remains
scene: Jehu's men come to bury Jezebel and find only her skull, feet and hands, fulfilling Elijah's word.
commons_file: 098.Jehu's Companions Find Jezebel's Remains.jpg

title: The Death of Athaliah
scene: Athaliah, crying 'Treason', is seized by the captains at Jehoiada's order and put to death outside the temple.
commons_file: 099.The Death of Athaliah.jpg

title: Foreign Nations Are Slain by Lions in Samaria
scene: The foreign peoples settled in Samaria by the Assyrian king are attacked by lions sent among them because they did not fear the LORD.
commons_file: 100.Foreign Nations Are Slain by Lions in Samaria.jpg

title: Sennacherib's Army Is Destroyed
scene: In the night the angel of the LORD strides sword in hand through the Assyrian camp beneath a lightning-torn sky, and Sennacherib's warriors and horses fall on every side.
commons_file: 101.Sennacherib's Army Is Destroyed.jpg

title: Zedekiah's Sons Are Slaughtered before His Eyes
scene: At Riblah the captured King Zedekiah is made to watch his sons put to death before he is blinded and bound.
commons_file: 102.Zedekiah's Sons Are Slaughtered before His Eyes.jpg

title: The Plague of Jerusalem
scene: As the plague sweeps through Jerusalem, a robed elder stands with both arms lifted to heaven in intercession while the dying and the grieving lie around him.
commons_file: 102A.The Plague of Jerusalem.jpg

title: The Ammonite and Moabite Armies Are Destroyed
scene: As Judah sings praise, the armies of Ammon, Moab and Mount Seir turn on one another and fall in the wilderness.
commons_file: 103.The Ammonite and Moabite Armies Are Destroyed.jpg

title: Cyrus Restores the Vessels of the Temple
scene: Cyrus king of Persia brings out the temple vessels Nebuchadnezzar had carried off and hands them over to Sheshbazzar for Jerusalem.
commons_file: 104.Cyrus Restores the Vessels of the Temple.jpg

title: The Rebuilding of the Temple Is Begun
scene: Returned exiles haul and set great stones for the house of the LORD while a leader lifts his hands in praise over the work.
commons_file: 105.The Rebuilding of the Temple Is Begun.jpg

title: Artaxerxes Grants Freedom to the Jews
scene: Before a Persian palace, King Artaxerxes' decree lets any of Israel who are willing go up to Jerusalem with Ezra.
commons_file: 106.Artaxerxes Grants Freedom to the Jews.jpg

title: Ezra Kneels in Prayer
scene: At the evening sacrifice Ezra, his garments torn, sinks down on the stone terrace with his head bowed low in grief and confession for the people, while the assembly gathers behind him.
commons_file: 107.Ezra Kneels in Prayer.jpg

title: Nehemiah Views the Ruins of Jerusalem's Walls
scene: Nehemiah rides out by night with a few companions to survey Jerusalem's broken walls and burned gates.
commons_file: 108.Nehemiah Views the Ruins of Jerusalem's Walls.jpg

title: Ezra Reads the Law to the People
scene: Standing on raised stone steps, Ezra holds up a tablet inscribed with the law and points to its words as he reads it aloud to the people gathered around and below him.
commons_file: 109.Ezra Reads the Law to the People.jpg

title: Queen Vashti Refuses to Obey Ahasuerus' Command
scene: Queen Vashti refuses the king's summons to appear at his feast, and Ahasuerus is filled with anger.
commons_file: 114.Queen Vashti Refuses to Obey Ahasuerus' Command.jpg

title: Esther Before the King
scene: Esther, in royal robes, comes unbidden into the king's inner court and, as in the Greek additions to Esther that Doré followed, sinks fainting into the arms of her maids, while Ahasuerus stands before his canopied throne.
commons_file: 115.Esther Before the King.jpg

title: The Triumph of Mordecai
scene: Haman leads Mordecai through the city on the king's horse in royal apparel, proclaiming the honor the king has given him.
commons_file: 116.The Triumph of Mordecai.jpg

title: Esther Accuses Haman
scene: At her banquet Esther pleads for her people and names Haman to the king as their enemy.
commons_file: 117.Esther Accuses Haman.jpg

title: Job Hears of His Misfortunes
scene: Messengers arrive one after another with news of Job's losses, one pointing back toward the burning fields, and Job stands stricken in his doorway with his hand pressed to his head while the women of his house fall to the ground in grief.
commons_file: 118.Job Hears of His Misfortunes.jpg

title: Job Speaks with His Friends
scene: Seated on a heap of straw in his affliction, Job lifts his arm toward heaven as he speaks, while Eliphaz, Bildad and Zophar stand and sit close beside him, one resting his chin on his hand as he listens.
commons_file: 119.Job Speaks with His Friends.jpg

title: The Prophet Isaiah
scene: The prophet Isaiah sits in quiet contemplation on a rock above a wide landscape, receiving the vision concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
commons_file: 120.The Prophet Isaiah.jpg

title: Isaiah's Vision of the Destruction of Babylon
scene: Isaiah's vision of fallen Babylon, its palaces and theaters in ruins and left to birds and wild creatures.
commons_file: 121.Isaiah's Vision of the Destruction of Babylon.jpg

title: The Destruction of Leviathan
scene: The LORD, with His great and strong sword, slays Leviathan, the twisting serpent of the sea.
commons_file: 122.The Destruction of Leviathan.jpg

title: The Prophet Jeremiah
scene: Under a storm-dark sky, Jeremiah sinks back against the stone steps, face lifted and one arm flung toward heaven, as he cries out the LORD's warning of disaster from the north, while listeners sit about him in sorrow.
commons_file: 123.The Prophet Jeremiah.jpg

title: Baruch Writes Jeremiah's Prophecies
scene: Baruch kneels with a writing tablet, taking down the LORD's words as Jeremiah stands above him in a shaft of light and speaks.
commons_file: 123.Baruch Writes Jeremiah's Prophecies.jpg

title: Baruch
scene: Faint with sorrow, Baruch the scribe sits slumped against a sunlit stone wall beside his scrolls, one hand pressed to his bowed head.
commons_file: 125.Baruch.jpg

title: People Mourn over the Destruction of Jerusalem
